_doc: The recurring cast (relationship system, scripts/career/relationships.gd). Each person has a relationship value 0-100 (start 50 = neutral; numbers in career_tuning.tres, 'Relationships') saved per career in CareerData.people, and story flags in CareerData.flags. Fields: id (used in scenario data: choices 'rel': {coach: 5}, requirements min/max 'rel_coach': 60, and {coach} in scenario text = the person's name), role (shown on the People screen; 'roles' overrides it per stage), icon (UiIcons), name: fixed text, or style coach ('Coach' + a last name), full (first + last), first, or list (pick from 'names' below), stages (where this person exists; default all), per_stage (a new person each stage; the old one moves to 'Former'), known_at_start (false = hidden on the People screen until a scenario changes the value), about (what they do for you, shown on the People screen), tiers (labels from a minimum value; default 'tiers' below).

people.about: Trust steadies you under pressure and gets you sent out for longer kicks. In your final recruiting year, a strong word helps (a weak one hurts).
Your teammates' trust in you. Made kicks build it, misses cost it (big kicks most of all). High trust calms you on game day and backs the coach's recommendation.
A holder you're in sync with means cleaner, more accurate kicks.
Helps your grades every season. One who vouches for you can get you past a college's GPA minimum.
Keeps your fun and social life up week to week.
As a friend he steadies you. As a rival he pushes you to get better. Games against his team are personal.
